name: CopilotMCPBridge
description: Connects a logged-in MMGIS browser session to the CopilotMCP backend so MCP clients can run the MMGIS Copilot's tools on this map.

descriptionFull.title: Browser half of the Copilot MCP interface. Enable it per mission (Configure → Components). It stays dormant unless the CopilotMCP backend is enabled (WITH_COPILOT_MCP=true) and the user is logged in; then it registers this page's session, executes MCP commands with the AgentChat Copilot handlers and reports the verified resulting state. A status indicator shows the connection and pauses it on click.

example.showIndicator: (bool) Show the MCP status indicator [default true]
example.mirrorToCopilotPanel: (bool) Also write MCP command output into the Copilot chat history [default false]

rows.name: Copilot MCP Bridge
rows.description: Lets MCP clients of the same MMGIS user control this mission's map through the Copilot tools. Requires the CopilotMCP backend plugin with WITH_COPILOT_MCP=true.

components.name: Auto Connect
components.description: Connect automatically after login. When off, the indicator starts paused and connects on click.

components.name: Show Indicator
components.description: Show the MCP connection indicator (click to pause/resume).

components.name: Mirror to Copilot Chat
components.description: Also write MCP command output into the Copilot chat (it becomes part of the chat history).
